definitions.explanation: Reusable chopsticks coated with lacquer, often decorated. The everyday chopsticks used at home, as opposed to disposable {割|わ}り{箸|ばし}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし}。
{塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Noodles slip easily off lacquered chopsticks.

examples.japanese: {輪島塗|わじまぬり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{夫婦箸|めおとばし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my parents a matching pair of Wajima-lacquer chopsticks.

notes:
⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to coat, to paint) + ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧ (chopsticks); hashi becomes -bashi in the compound (rendaku).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}→割り箸：09725_waribashi⟧: disposable wooden chopsticks that you split apart
- ⟦{菜箸|さいばし}→菜箸：04473_saibashi⟧: long cooking chopsticks
- {夫婦箸|めおとばし}: a matched pair of chopsticks for a married couple, a common gift

{輪島|わじま} (Ishikawa) and {若狭|わかさ} (Fukui) are known for lacquered chopsticks.
